messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.descrip: Prepare the Last Ember notes for the gate by gathering eyes and the courage to face what answers them.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: The pearls and fire point toward a door that does not care whether anyone is ready.
Bring eyes of ender, and proof you can meet the staring dark. The village needs the lesson before the gate, not after.
messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: I will prepare for the gate.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: Defeat endermen and bring eyes of ender. The gate should not be the first time your hands shake.
messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: Bring 3 eyes of ender for the gate notes.
The staring dark has been answered.
Defeat 3 endermen without letting fear write the lesson for you.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: That is allowed. A gate does not become kinder because you hurry toward it.
Look away when you must. Courage is not staring until you break.
Defeat 3 endermen and bring 3 eyes of ender for the gate lesson.
The gate lesson is not open right now.
The gate notes are already steady.
Defeat 3 endermen and bring 3 eyes of ender. We are not opening anything today; we are learning how not to panic tomorrow.
The gate lesson is not ready right now.
messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: Defeat 3 endermen and bring 3 eyes of ender.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.r: The notes are ready to wait for the gate. That may be the hardest part.
Good. The third note says this: a door is not destiny until someone walks through it.
The gate lesson is still missing something.
Bring the gate materials here before we seal the notes.
I cannot close the gate lesson right now.
The notes remain open, which is another way of saying vulnerable.
messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.r: Return with the sealed gate materials.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.s: The eyes are enough to point. Bring an ender chest so the notes can wait without whispering from an ordinary drawer.
messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.s: Bring 1 ender chest to keep the Last Ember notes sealed.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.s: Some notes deserve a lid that knows how to stay shut.
Bring 1 ender chest to seal the Last Ember notes.
The steady-hands lesson can wait until the eyes are ready.
messages.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.title: Before Dawn
